mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, feature, subject_a_id, subject_b_id, content_hash, payload, warnings, generated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM ai_output_cache c JOIN workspace owner_workspace ON owner_workspace.id = #{workspaceId} JOIN workspace cache_workspace ON cache_workspace.id = c.workspace_id AND cache_workspace.org_id = owner_workspace.org_id WHERE ( c.feature LIKE 'report.narrative:%' OR (c.feature LIKE 'intro.rationale:%' AND (c.subject_a_id = #{personId} OR c.subject_b_id = #{personId})) OR (c.feature LIKE 'deal.risk_rationale:%' AND c.subject_a_id IN ( SELECT dp.deal_id FROM deal_person dp WHERE dp.person_id = #{personId} )) OR (c.feature LIKE 'deal.brief:%' AND c.subject_a_id IN ( SELECT dp.deal_id FROM deal_person dp WHERE dp.person_id = #{personId} UNION SELECT a.deal_id FROM activity a WHERE a.person_id = #{personId} AND a.deal_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT n.deal_id FROM note n WHERE n.person_id = #{personId} AND n.deal_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT t.deal_id FROM task t WHERE t.person_id = #{personId} AND t.deal_id IS NOT NULL )) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_output_cache (workspace_id, feature, subject_a_id, subject_b_id, content_hash, payload, warnings, generated_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{feature}, #{subjectAId}, #{subjectBId}, #{contentHash}, #{payload}, #{warnings}, #{generatedAt}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_hash = incoming.content_hash, payload = incoming.payload, warnings = incoming.warnings, generated_at = incoming.generated_at
